description: Connect a new database or spreadsheet to your workspace. Test the settings with test_data_source_connection first: this tool saves them whether or not they work. Subject to your plan's data source limit.

config.description: Connection settings for this connector type, for example { host, port, database, username, password, ssl } for postgres. Credentials are stored encrypted at rest and are never returned by read tools.

name.description: A name for this connection, shown in the dashboard editor.

type.description: Connector type. Call list_supported_data_connectors for the settings each one expects.

name: add_data_source
title: Add a data source
